ios.desc:
Protect against online threats & other types of malware with Avast One, our free All-in-one Mobile security app for iOS. Trusted by hundreds of millions. 

Avast One is your personal digital guardian; choose protection your way, for your life's online moments.  

Avast One  
- Avast Free Security - Stay safer from scams and malware with award-winning (AV-Comparatives) security that’s free and easy-to-use  
- Scam Guardian - Stay safer from scams with expert help  
- Avast SecureLine VPN - Keep your online activities hidden from internet service providers, hackers, and advertisers with our private VPN  
- Avast Cleanup - Clean up your devices by getting rid of junk files like browser history, duplicate photos, and old contacts  
- Mobile Security - Keep your device safer against malware with 24/7 protection  
- Hack Alert - Stay informed about password leaks  
- Network Inspector (Wi-Fi Security) - Confidently connect to Wi-Fi anywhere. Stop hackers from accessing your personal data.  
- Secure your device against phishing attacks from emails and infected websites  

Scam Guardian  
- 24/7 AI-powered scam protection 
- Web Guard - Advanced AI tools to help keep you safe from hidden scams while browsing, banking, and shopping online. Scan and block malware-infected links, as well as Trojans, adware, and spyware (for privacy and safe web browsing, e.g. Chrome).  
- Avast Assistant - Think someone’s trying to scam you? Get answers quickly from Avast Assistant, your built-in AI partner  

Scam Guardian Pro  
- Call Guard (Call Blocker) - Automatically blocks scam calls and labels if the call is a potential scam, spam, or a verified business 
- Safe SMS - AI-powered scam protection for every text message  
- Email Guard - It flags potential email scams, phishing, and infected attachments so you'll always know what's safe to open. 

Avast SecureLine VPN  
- Protect your privacy  
- Keep your online activities hidden from internet service providers, hackers, and advertisers with our private VPN (Virtual Private Network).  
- Use the perfect location for whatever you’re doing  
- Connect to over 100 locations worldwide, so you can enjoy what you’re doing more securely and privately.  
- Watch shows and sports wherever you are more safely with streaming-optimized servers
